name: unsafe fn drop_in_place < T : ? Sized > (to_drop : * mut T)
rule: If `T` is not `Copy`, using the pointed-to value after calling `drop_in_place` can cause undefined behavior; assigning with `*to_drop = foo` counts as such a use because it drops the value again.
api: unsafe fn drop_in_place < T : ? Sized > (to_drop : * mut T)
